notes.title: Guildmaster Story: Now Available on Steam!
notes.notes:
After a year in mobile exclusivity, Windows and MacOS gamers can now purchase [b]Guildmaster Story[/b]: A puzzle-match comedy about fame, misfortune and working for nothing.

[previewyoutube=T_Hdj0AhA7I;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The writing and storytelling remains at the forefront of the experience, and as a fan of other WZOGI games, you'll no doubt love this one as well! Learn more at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122310/Guildmaster_Story/]our brand new page on Steam![/url]

notes.title: OS X Support! Bigger, Clearer Text!
notes.notes:
In anticipation of even greater news to follow, Actual Sunlight has now been updated to RPG Maker MV, meaning that a Mac OS X version is now available!

This version also features a higher native resolution with bigger, clearer text, and other minor quality-of-life upgrades that bring it more closely in sync with the PS Vita version of the game.

Check it out!

notes.title: Little Red Lie Is Next Game From Actual Sunlight Creator
notes.notes:
Little Red Lie [official site] is a game inspired by the “growing gap in wealth and stability between the baby boomers and their descendants” and is the latest project from Actual Sunlight creator Will O’Neill. Much like O’Neill’s previous work, Little Red Lie looks to explore the human condition and how we fare as human beings in trying times and compromising situations. Taking a similar interactive story approach to Actual Sunlight, the game follows two characters at opposite ends of the wealth spectrum examining their overlapping relationship.
